Bihar Board Class 12th Inter Exam Compartment Result 2026
Post Date / Update : 23 May 2026 | 11:11 AM
Short Information

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) Bihar Board will soon release the results for the Class 12th Intermediate (Inter) Annual Board Exam 2026. The answer key has already been released for enrolled candidates. Candidates can check it and verify their answers. Candidates with objections to any answers can submit them within the deadline and time specified by the board. After the objection process is complete, the BSEB will declare the final result. Candidates will be able to check their results/marks by entering their roll code and roll number on the official website. The official result date will be announced soon.

BSEB Bihar Board Class 12th Inter Result 2026

Bihar Board BSEB XIIth Results 2026:  Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • BSEB Class 12 Inter Exam : February 2026
  • BSEB 12th Result Declared Date : 23 March 2026 at 01:30 PM
  • BSEB 12th Compartment Result : 23 May 2026 at 04 PM

Exam Conducted By

  • BSEB Patna – Bihar School of Examination Board Will be Conducted the Examination of  Inter Class 12th Annual Board Examination 2026.

How to Check Bihar Board 12th Result 2026

  • In this year 2026 around 13.70+ lakhs are registered in Bihar Board Intermediate Class 12th Exam.
  • This year Bihar Board Inter Class 12 Exam was held from February 2026.
  • This year the result of Bihar Board Inter XIIth examination will be released on March 2026 at 23/03/2026 at 01:30 PM by Bihar Board
  • What documents / details will be required to check the result of Bihar Board Inter class 12th exam this year.
  • To check the result of Bihar Board Class 12 Inter Examination 2026, the candidate will need the roll code and roll number.
  • Candidates who do not have roll number and roll code available or not known can check it in their admit card or can check from their school/college/board.
  • Bihar Board Class 12 Result of all stream Result will be released on March 2026 together.
  • Candidates can also check their subject wise result of the exam.
  • Stream Wise Toppers information will also be released by the Bihar Board.



Bihar Board 12th Inter Result 2026 : Direct Link / Website List

  • Bihar Board Class 12 Result 2026 will also be available on these website. The direct link to check the result will also be available in some useful important links at the bottom of this page.
  • interbiharboard.com
  • bsebexam.com
  • biharboardonline.com
  • Direct Link Also Available at SarkariResult.Com
  • In the year 2022 of Bihar Board BSEB Inter Class 12th, a total of 80.15 percent students passed.
  • In the Year 2023 of Bihar Board BSEB Inter Class 12th, a total of 83.70 percent students passed.
  • In the year 2024 of Bihar Board BSEB Inter Class 12th, a total of 87.21 percent students passed.
  • In the Last Year 2025 of Bihar Board BSEB Inter Class 12th, a total of 86.50% percent students passed.
  • In the this year 2026 of Bihar Board BSEB Inter Class 12th, a total of 85.19% percent students passed.
